description: Running has long been associated with chasing faster times and who crosses the finish line first. But a growing number of runners in South Korea are embracing a different philosophy: slowing down. At My Pace Morning, a Seoul Metropolitan Government running program held in Yeouido on Sunday, there were no sprints to the finish. description: A fire broke out at a logistics center operated by the retail giant Coupang in the western port city of Incheon on Saturday, but no casualties were reported, authorities said. Some 100 firefighters and around 50 pieces of equipment were mobilized to put out the fire, which broke out at 6:54 a.m., according to firefighting authorities. Officials added they plan to investigate the exact cause of the fire once the blaze is extinguished. (Yonhap)
title: Fire breaks out at Coupang logistics center in Incheon
